name: Matsunaga Shin'ichi
source:
Orihara Akane's 20-year-old childhood friend.
He is a character in "The House with the Red Roof", but also the storyteller, "S-san".
He hasn't been in contact with Akane since elementary school.

[Translated from the [url=https://game.mages.co.jp/shikai/#character]official website[/url]]
